evidence.decision: Decides which related views deserve simultaneous space, how to collapse them while preserving state and how each supported input completes the same operations.
evidence.artifact: Requires a wide/narrow task flow plus input mapping or corresponding implementation, including cross-app import landing behavior.
evidence.transformation: Score editor replaces repeated full-screen tool round trips with contextual tools that collapse at compact width without losing page/selection/undo.
evidence.verification: Shrinking-selection loss, hover-only touch blockers and imported-content replacement are explicit failures; Pencil/reach/drag claims need device evidence.
evidence.applicability: Works without attached accessories, treats multitasking as normal and separates iPad-on-Mac adaptation from an unsupported native-equivalence claim.
evidence.handoffs: Routes resizing to Layout, actual drawing/writing to Pencil/Scribble and precision input to Pointing devices.
evidence.distinctiveness: Persistent score/canvas relationships and input switching make this an iPad workspace procedure rather than a larger-phone summary.
